finalOutput:
All tests pass — the full game loop, restart cycle, pause/resume, reversal guard, all three modes, and game-over detection work correctly (the earlier "still running: false" was just the second unsteered PvP game ending as expected; a dedicated follow-up test confirmed the restarted game plays and reaches game over normally).

The game is complete in a single file: **`snake_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html`** (651 lines, HTML + CSS + JS).

**Features implemented:**
- **30×30 grid** rendered on a 600×600 canvas with a checkerboard background
- **Classic mechanics** — continuous movement, grows 2 segments per food, dies on wall/self/other-snake collision (with correct tail-vacation and head-on collision rules)
- **Keyboard controls** — Player 1: `WASD`, Player 2: `Arrow keys`, with 180°-reversal prevention
- **CPU AI** — BFS pathfinding to the nearest food; when no path exists, it picks the move maximizing reachable free space (flood fill), so CPU snakes survive long and score well (test run: CPU 38 vs 8)
- **Three modes** — `1` Human vs Human, `2` CPU vs Human, `3` CPU vs CPU (selectable via menu buttons or number keys)
- **Live HUD** — both scores, player labels (CPU/Player), mode name, dead players struck through
- **Start menu** and **game over screen** with winner announcement and final scores
- **Restart** with `Space`, back to menu with `Esc`, pause with `P`
- Polished visuals: glowing pulsing food, gradient snake bodies with eyes, blurred overlays, responsive sizing

Open the file in any browser to play.
